name: Palisades Center
summary: Palisades Center is a four-level regional mall featuring 218 stores and restaurants, complemented by exceptional entertainment amenities including a cinema, ice skating rink, and bowling alley. This sprawling shopping destination serves as the premier retail and entertainment hub for the Hudson Valley region.
demographics: Palisades Center attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic from Rockland County and northern New Jersey, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area serves a mix of suburban families, young professionals, and multi-generational shoppers seeking both value and variety. Visitors typically range from ages 25-54 with household incomes between $75,000-$150,000, drawn by the center's combination of mainstream retail, entertainment options, and dining experiences. The center's extensive entertainment amenities particularly appeal to families with children and teenagers, making it a weekend destination for the broader Hudson Valley region.
description: Palisades Center stands as one of the premier shopping destinations in the Hudson Valley region, offering an unparalleled retail and entertainment experience under one roof in West Nyack, New York. Since its opening, this sprawling four-level enclosed mall has established itself as a regional powerhouse, featuring 218 stores and restaurants that cater to every shopping need and preference. Beyond traditional retail, Palisades Center distinguishes itself with world-class entertainment amenities including a state-of-the-art cinema, full-size ice skating rink, and bowling alley, transforming the typical mall visit into an all-day family destination. The center's diverse tenant mix ranges from popular fashion retailers and department stores to specialty shops and an impressive dining collection, ensuring visitors can shop, dine, and play without ever leaving the property. With its convenient location just off the Palisades Interstate Parkway and extensive parking facilities, Palisades Center serves as the go-to shopping hub for residents across Rockland County, northern New Jersey, and the greater New York metropolitan area.
